body.statement: The explicit construction in \(\mathrm{thm:smooth\text{-}splice\text{-}pair}\) yields \(\inf_{\widetilde\Gamma_N\in\mathfrak E_{\Gamma,N}}\sup_{P\in\mathcal M_\star}\mathbb E_{P^{\otimes N}}\|\widetilde\Gamma_N-\Gamma(P)\|_{\mathrm{op}}\asymp(\log N)^{-1}\) and \(\inf_{\widetilde\Theta_N\in\mathfrak E_{\Theta,N}}\sup_{P\in\mathcal M_\star}\mathbb E_{P^{\otimes N}}d_H(\widetilde\Theta_N,\Theta_{TY}(\Gamma(P),\preceq))\asymp(\log N)^{-1}\). Moreover, for every \((S_N)\in\mathfrak C_\alpha(\mathcal M_\star)\), the constructed collision laws satisfy \(\liminf_{N\to\infty}P_{0,N}^{\otimes N}\{\operatorname{diam}(S_N)\ge|b(s_N)-b(0)|\}\ge1-2\alpha\), where \(P_{0,N},P_{1,N}\in\mathcal M_{\mathrm{col}}\) and \(|b(s_N)-b(0)|\asymp(\log N)^{-1}\).
body.justification: The verified positive smooth splice supplies logarithmic covariance and singleton causal-target separations with vanishing product total variation. It matches the fixed Fourier-class upper bounds and forces an honest confidence set to contain both collision effects with limiting probability at least \(1-2\alpha\).
body.gap: Belomestny--Trabs--Tsybakov provide a covariance minimax precedent. This theorem adds an explicit moment-compatible three-variable lower pair, a distinct Hausdorff lower bound for the singleton causal-effect target, and a quantified honest-diameter event on an exact collision stratum. The lower construction also lies in the Sanjaroonpouri--Ramazi published class, so the lower conclusions transfer there without asserting a corresponding upper rate.
body.consumer: For the \(\texttt{pcalg::ida}\) and yeast intervention-ranking workflow, the result rules out uniformly faster audited mixed-noise effect precision through order selection or collision testing; an honest procedure must retain the logarithmic-scale compatible-effect uncertainty.
